racing.title: Car racing
racing.blurb: Top-down racing. The agent sees the track and steers; an untrained one spins on the grass, a trained one follows the road.

boxing.title: Boxing
boxing.blurb: Hand to hand. Score is punches landed minus punches taken, so it runs from -100 to +100 and reads at a glance.

platformer.title: Platformer
platformer.blurb: Climb the ladders, punch the monkeys, reach the top. The legal stand-in for Mario: a platformer with ROMs that ship licensed.

pingpong.title: Table tennis
pingpong.blurb: Score runs from -21 to +21, so there is nowhere for a weak agent to hide: it starts losing every rally and ends winning them.
